title: Practice 2: Нет, не было: having none

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: There are no towels in room 15.
exercises.why: Conversely, to say 'There isn't...', 'There aren't...', we use the word **нет** followed by the genitive case. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 27.  ·  «The direct object of a verb with negation (with не) is often in the genitive case instead of the accusative.» «Conversely, to say 'There isn't...', 'There aren't...', we use the word нет followed by the genitive case.» — DLI, Lesson 27; Wikibooks, «Genitive case».
